description: Przypadki testowe dla GitHub Issues zgłaszanych przez użytkowników – błędy infrastruktury, konfiguracji, CI

input_event.title: Infrastructure CI failure: 'npm ci' fails with 'ENOENT: no such file or directory, open package-lock.json'
input_event.body:
The CI pipeline fails during the npm ci step.

Error:
```
npm error code ENOENT
npm error syscall open
npm error path /home/runner/work/iot-agent-login-screen/iot-agent-login-screen/package-lock.json
npm error errno -2
npm error enoent ENOENT: no such file or directory, open 'package-lock.json'
```

This happens on every PR. The project builds locally.

input_event.title: Maven build failure: artifact 'iot-agent-common:1.5.3' not found in Nexus
input_event.body:
CI pipeline fails with:
```

Could not resolve dependencies for project AGH-iot-agent:iot-agent-device-api:jar:0.0.1-SNAPSHOT:

```

input_event.title: Reusable workflow fails: env context not available in 'with' block
input_event.body:
The GitHub Actions reusable workflow fails with:
```
The workflow is not valid. .github/workflows/deploy.yml (Line: 24, Col: 16): 
Context access might be invalid: env.IMAGE_TAG
```
We are trying to pass `${{ env.IMAGE_TAG }}` in the `with:` block of a reusable workflow call.

input_event.title: Service cannot connect to PostgreSQL: 'Connection refused' on localhost:5432
input_event.body:
The microservice iot-agent-dashboard-api fails to start in K8s:
```
org.postgresql.util.PSQLException: Connection to localhost:5432 refused. 
Check that the hostname and port are correct and that the postmaster is accepting TCP/IP connections.
```
The database service is deployed as 'postgresql-service' in namespace 'iotag-dev'.

input_event.title: Orphaned ConfigMaps and Secrets after namespace cleanup
input_event.body:
After removing the 'iot-agent-stream-worker' deployment we found orphaned resources:
- ConfigMap 'stream-worker-config' still exists in iotag-dev
- Secret 'stream-worker-db-secret' still exists in iotag-dev
These may cause confusion or security issues. Please audit and remove safely.
